title: Saikyou no Kensei, Bishoujo Maid ni Tensei Shi Houki de Musou Suru
titleRomaji: Saikyou no Kensei, Bishoujo Maid ni Tensei Shi Houki de Musou Suru

synonyms: The strongest sword saint is reincarnated as a beautiful maid and becomes unrivaled with a broom
synopsis: Arnoick, the strongest Sword Saint in history, has died. His sword techniques were passed on to his disciples, and it was thought that his story had come to an end— But then…! Arnoick is reincarnated as a breathtakingly beautiful maid named Annette! With her slender arms and frail body, she should have given up the path of the sword and lived a quiet, peaceful life. However, in order to protect Rosalena, the daughter of a fallen noble family, she rises up broom in hand. An ultimate do-over fantasy of the strongest warrior reborn—from old man to beautiful girl! (Comic Gardo Translated)

synonyms: Nito no Taidana Isekai Shoukougun Sai Jakushoku "Healer" Nano ni Saikyou wa Desu ka?
synopsis: Hidako Masamune is a high school student who suffers from continuous bullying by his classmates. Becoming tired of it all, he decides to commit suicide, but instead he is transported to another world along with all his classmates. When they arrive, they find that they now possess amazing abilities but he was only granted the status of a "healer," the weakest skill of all. The king decides to get rid of him by transporting him to another far away place, but not before Hidako swears revenge against the king, the kingdom, and all of his classmates.

synopsis: Su, born in prison, has always wanted to see the "crow" from the story her mother told her. On the day she was going to be secretly executed, Gill, an artificial intelligence with a database of everything outside the prison, was thrown into prison for a test run. Su develops a special feeling for Gill, not caring whether her words are programmed or self-conscious, and not trying to tell if she has human emotions. Unable to distinguish her own human feelings... in this small cell, the lonely Su got her first doll--she met a "person" who could comfort her soul.

synonyms: A Story Of Taking Home A Lonely Gal From My Class And Turning Her Into An Elegant Beauty
Class no botti GAL wo omotikaeri shite seisokei-bijin ni shiteyatta hanashi
synopsis: On a rainy night, Akira Akamori, a high school boy about to transfer to a new school, sees his blonde-haired classmate, Aoi Sotome, standing in the park drenched from the rain. “…I don’t have a home anymore.” Though he doesn't know Aoi well at all, Akira couldn’t leave a girl alone in the rain, so he took her home. “Thanks for the help.” “Y- You're welcome…” When Akira hears about Aoi’s complicated situation, he decides to help her and let her live with him until he transfers to his new school. While their new cohabitation arrangement seems a little confusing at first, the two slowly grow close to each other. It is a love story of two people who repeatedly come together and drift apart, like a spinning record.

title: Uesugi-kun Wants to Quit Being a Girl
titleEnglish: Uesugi-kun Wants to Quit Being a Girl
titleNative: 上杉くんは女の子をやめたい
synonyms: Uesugi-kun wants to quit being a girl
synopsis: In this gender-bending rom-com manga, one young man's wish for love will change him—literally! Uesugi Keisuke has always struggled with being short and adorable compared to his super smart and tall best friend. One day, he overhears his crush comment, "Wouldn't he be the cutest if he was a girl?!" This makes him worry she doesn't even see him as a guy. Down in the dumps, he prays at the shrine next to his house in the hopes that he can still achieve young love. However, it seems there was a major misunderstanding, because when his prayer is answered, he winds up transformed into a girl! Thus begins Uesugi's gender-bent love triangle! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
